question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

He's sitting on the fence
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "He can't take a decision." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: • The idiom **"sitting on the fence"** means **to be undecided or neutral about a situation, not taking either side of an argument or issue.** (किसी मुद्दे को लेकर निर्णय न लेना, समर्थन न करना और विरोध भी न करना) • *Example*: • *​**They are **sitting on the fence** and refusing to commit themselves.* • So, in this context, the only possible answer is option 4, 'He can't take a decision,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase. Correct meaning:__* He can't take a decision.* 3f:T9d68,
